1.text: Indirimbo ya Dawidi y'Amazamuka.Iyaba Uwiteka atari we wari uri mu ruhande rwacu,Abe ari ko Abisirayeli bavuga none.

2.text: Iyaba Uwiteka atari we wari uri mu ruhande rwacu,Ubwo abantu baduhagurukiraga,

3.text: Baba baratumize bunguri tukiri bazima,Ubwo umujinya wabo wacanwaga kuri twe.

4.text: Amazi aba yaraturengeye rwose,Isūri iba yaratembye ku bugingo bwacu,

5.text: Amazi yihindurije aba yaratembye ku bugingo bwacu.

6.text: Uwiteka ahimbazwe,Utadutanze kuba nk'umuhīgo w'amenyo yabo.

7.text: Ubugingo bwacu bukize nk'uko inyoni iva mu kigoyi cy'abagoyi,Ikigoyi kiracitse, natwe tuvamo turakira.

8.text: Gutabarwa kwacu kubonerwa mu izina ry'Uwiteka,Waremye ijuru n'isi.
